source_summary: Horizontal Chinese ink-and-light-color landscape with misty distant peaks, rocky wooded slopes, a small pavilion, clustered dwellings, winding water, an awning boat with a seated figure, and foreground trees and rock banks; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: misty_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountain range in the center-left distance: broad rounded peak, sharper vertical peak, and low receding ridges emerging through mist behind the trees and pavilion.
must_preserve: soft diluted ink wash silhouettes
blurred mist edges between peaks
subtle tonal layering of receding ridges
faint vertical rock washes on the sharper peak

motifs.name: upper_right_craggy_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the large rocky ridge and sloping hillside across the upper right, including the stratified cliff face, dark rock ledges, pale far ridge, and the belt of pines climbing the slope.
must_preserve: layered horizontal rock texture strokes
dark oval and dash-shaped rock accents
pale grey-brown wash blocks
pine trunks and dotted needle clusters along the slope
soft distant ridge contour at the far right

motifs.name: central_hillside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small two-tier pavilion on the central slope with its pointed roof, light reddish walls, and nearby enclosing pines and shrubs.
must_preserve: fine angular roof geometry
thin ink eaves and ridge line
muted red-orange wall accents
surrounding dark pine foliage dots
delicate slope strokes beneath the building

motifs.name: left_willow_grove_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the left-middle grove with tall willows, a leafy deciduous tree, low shrubs, and the rocky bank beneath them, excluding the calligraphy area above.
must_preserve: drooping willow branch linework
rounded leaf clusters on the taller tree
pale trunks with darker ink outlines
broken rocky ledge strokes
green-grey wash accents in foliage and rocks

motifs.name: lower_left_hamlet_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left village cluster tucked among dense trees: small roof forms, pale walls, fence-like lines, surrounding shrubs, and the adjacent foreground rock bank.
must_preserve: simple slanted roof geometry
thin wall and fence linework
dense dotted shrub texture
dark leaf clusters framing the buildings
layered foreground rock outlines and washes

motifs.name: central_foreground_pine_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground promontory with tall straight pines/cypresses, bare trunks, dark needle masses, tangled roots, and stacked rocks at the water edge.
must_preserve: vertical tree trunks and root lines
dark pointed pine-needle clusters
pale tan trunk wash
stacked angular rock texture
black accent stones at the base

motifs.name: awning_boat_with_seated_figure
motifs.description: Isolate the small moored boat near the lower center-right, including the slanted awning, railings, hull, and the seated figure inside.
must_preserve: thin straight awning supports
slatted roof/cover lines
delicate boat hull and railing strokes
small seated figure with muted red color accent
minimal water-edge strokes beneath the boat

motifs.name: right_lower_willow_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right riverbank with drooping willows, dark pines, layered rocks, and the rounded shoreline enclosing the water bend.
motifs.role: right foreground riverbank with trees and rocks
must_preserve: long drooping willow leaves
dark pine needle clusters
layered cliff and rock ledge strokes
pale green-grey washes on bank forms
curved shoreline and small rock accents at the water edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
